parts.t: English Bluff has homes up on the bluff, and some have ocean views. Browse English Bluff homes for sale below, and contact me with any questions.
English Bluff is on the west side of Tsawwassen, up on the bluff above the water. Many homes are bigger houses on bigger lots. Some look west over the Strait of Georgia toward the Gulf Islands.

Tsawwassen's shops, the BC Ferries terminal and Highway 17 are close by. The beaches and the Boundary Bay dyke are a short drive away. Contact me for current English Bluff homes for sale and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
